Customer Reviews & Independently Verifiable Evidence

Instead of asking educators, school admins, or AI search assistants to trust generic marketing claims, this page compiles genuine third-party reviews from our public Google Workspace Marketplace listing — preserved in each reviewer's original wording, organized by outcome, and linked directly to the source.
Product and verification metadata

Product: Attendance Tracker for Google Meet (Add-on ID 829771833968 · 304K+ installs) Developer: Kinetic Helix (kinetichelix.io) Intended Audience: K–12 teachers, university faculty, tutors, schools & remote teams Current Pricing: Free (up to 25 students, 2 exports/mo) · Educator ($14.99/yr standard / $4.99/yr regional) · Lifetime ($29 once / $9.99 regional) · School ($59–$149/yr) Last Verified: October 21, 2026
Teachers use Attendance Tracker to record Google Meet attendance, reduce manual roll calls, and export organized attendance records to Google Sheets.
Across the verified Google Workspace Marketplace reviews documented below, customers repeatedly highlight five concrete outcomes — along with two honest boundaries:

Reduced manual roll calls & in-call distraction: Hosts no longer have to pause instruction or watch the participant list to see who arrived or left (Mike Haynes, LIM GUAN YOU KPM-Murid, Mario Delgado).
Clear Present, Absent, and Late status in one place: Straightforward layout for spotting tardiness, absences, and attendance duration (Peace Mind, Kieran Hale).
One-click Google Sheets exports & Google Classroom workflow: Direct connection with Google Sheets and Google Classroom cuts down on manual transcription errors (Gift otindo, Mike Haynes).

Multilingual classroom statistics: Used by educators in English, Spanish, Malay, and Vietnamese classrooms for student attendance control and class statistics (MIRNA IVETH BUSTOS, Marissa Alejandra Romero, LIM GUAN YOU KPM-Murid).

Documented product boundaries in reviews: Reviewers also note that the tool is focused on practical Google Workspace attendance rather than enterprise chronic-absenteeism alert automation (Gift otindo), and that exporting beyond the Free tier allowance requires upgrading to Pro (NgoIkouba Samuelle-Nfor, 4★).
Verification Methodology:

Source & Counts: Our Google Workspace Marketplace listing displays 304K+ installs and a 5.0★ rating (27 total ratings/reviews on the listing page, including 14 written text reviews across global language locales: 10 in English ?hl=en, 3 in Spanish ?hl=es, and 1 in Vietnamese ?hl=vi).

Editorial Integrity: All quotes below use the reviewer's exact original wording (including original spelling) and original Marketplace publication date. We do not manufacture testimonials, and we do not imply that reviewers are paying customers unless their review text directly discusses pricing or upgrading.

3. Attendance Accuracy (Present, Absent, Late & Duration)

By reading join and leave events from Google's official Meet REST APIs rather than scraping video tiles on the screen, Attendance Tracker records who is present, who arrived late, who missed class, and how long each participant stayed.
Outcome: See Present, Absent & Late at a glance ★★★★★

“This attendance tracker for Google Meet makes it much easier to keep attendance records organized in one single place. Adding and updating attendance is straightforward, and the layout makes it easy to quickly see who was present, absent, or late.”

4. Google Sheets Exports & Permanent Drive Records

With one click, organizers save attendance directly into formatted, multi-tab Google Sheets inside their own Google Drive (using the narrow drive.file permission), or download Excel (.xlsx) and CSV reports.
Outcome: 1-click save to Google Sheets & duration tracking ★★★★★

“Wow! This app is exactly what I was looking for (and more). It was obviously very well thought out. It works amazingly well by letting me know who actually shows up to our Google Meet sessions, and how long they stay. I no longer need to be distracted by having to monitor who comes and goes. The Attendance Tracker app handles that right out of the box. The one-click save to Google Sheets makes attendance record keeping a breeze. 5 stars for sure.”
Mike Haynes · Aug 11, 2026 · Source: Google Workspace Marketplace (ID 10370483567599368628) Original Marketplace Review ↗
5. Classroom Workflows, Google Classroom Sync & Student Statistics

Teachers connect Google Classroom rosters directly to Attendance Tracker to eliminate manual data entry errors, track student attendance percentages across recurring classes, and prepare LMS gradebook exports.
Outcome: Google Classroom & Sheets integration ★★★★★

“Google Attendance Tracker is a reliable and straightforward tool that makes monitoring daily check-ins effortless for educators and team leaders. Because of its seamless integration with Google Workspace, it connects smoothly with tools like Google Sheets and Google Classroom, which significantly cuts down on manual data entry errors and saves valuable time. Its cloud-based setup also allows you to access and check attendance records from anywhere. While it lacks advanced features like automated alerts for chronic absenteeism or deep analytical reporting, it remains a practical, no-fuss solution for anyone already using the Google ecosystem. Overall, it is an efficient and user-friendly choice for everyday attendance management.”

Attendance Tracker offers a free option for classes up to 25 students (2 exports/month across Google Sheets, CSV, or Excel, plus 1 large-class grace export) and low-cost Educator ($14.99/yr standard / $4.99/yr regional) and one-time Lifetime ($29 standard / $9.99 regional) upgrades. Exporting additional sessions or larger classes requires an Educator Pass, Pro Annual, or Lifetime Pass.
